result.summary: The page is mostly clean. The main defect is a '-0%' discount badge on the second Popular card, which looks like a data or formatting bug. There are also two cosmetic issues: a repeated '€0 delivery' label on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card and inconsistent contrast on the favorite (heart) buttons.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza) shows a discount badge reading '-0%'. A zero-percent discount is meaningless and looks like a bug, probably a missing value or a badge rendered when no promotion is active.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 or null, and check the promotion data binding for this restaurant.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows '€0 delivery' twice: as an overlay badge on the image and again in the metadata row below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery information in one place only, or use the badge for a different promotion so the card is less cluttered.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button's circular background is inconsistent. On the ramen card it blends into the dark image and is barely visible, while on the pizza card it is clearly visible. This makes the button's tap target and contrast inconsistent across cards.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent semi-opaque backdrop behind the heart icon, such as a dark translucent or white circle, so it stays visible on any image.
